chunks: Muhammad ibn al-Hassan ibn Mahbub narrated from Ahmad, from his father, from Ibn Abi Umayr, from Ibn Miskan, from al-Ahwal, from a man who paid the zakat of his wealth early, then the recipient became wealthy before the due date of the year, who said:
The giver must repeat (pay) the zakat.

key_terms.رَأْسِ السَّنَةِ: The head/start of the year (due date)

ai.seo_question: What happens to early zakat payment if the recipient becomes rich before the due date?
ai.summary: This narration from *Tahdhib al-Ahkam* establishes that if a recipient of zakat becomes wealthy (no longer eligible) before the completion of the zakat year, the giver must repeat the payment. This ruling highlights the Shia scholarly emphasis on the continuous validity of the recipient's status throughout the entire zakat period, ensuring the charity fulfills its specific legal purpose.
